items.exampleEn: The colors of my old jeans have faded.
items.exampleZh: 我那條舊牛仔褲的顏色已經褪了。

items.exampleEn: The school is a respected establishment in our town.
items.exampleZh: 這所學校是我們鎮上受敬重的機構。

items.exampleEn: Animals adapt to the place where they live.
items.exampleZh: 動物會適應牠們生活的地方。

items.exampleEn: The money will be distributed equally among the five winners.
items.exampleZh: 這筆錢會平均分給五位得獎者。

items.exampleEn: How much do I owe you for the tickets?
Mount Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan.
items.exampleZh: 富士山是日本最高的山。

items.exampleEn: After ten hard rounds, she was the only survivor in the quiz.
items.exampleZh: 經過十輪激烈的比賽，她是問答賽中唯一留下來的人。

items.exampleEn: There are traces of paint on his shoes.
items.exampleZh: 他的鞋子上有油漆的痕跡。

items.sentenceEn: The memory of that summer will never fade.
items.sentenceZh: 那個夏天的回憶永遠不會褪色。

items.audioEn: Our store will distribute free bags to the first hundred customers this Saturday.
items.audioZh: 本店這週六將免費贈送袋子給前一百位顧客。

items.sentenceEn: We must adapt to the new rules.
He owes his success to his parents.

items.stemEn: There was no ____ of the cookies; my brother ate them all.
items.stemZh: 餅乾一點痕跡都沒留下；我弟弟全吃光了。

items.stemEn: The light from the old lamp began to ____.
items.stemZh: 那盞舊燈的光開始變暗。

items.passageEn: Last year, my family went to Japan to climb Mount Fuji. Before the trip, we had to adapt to getting up early, because we planned to start at three in the morning. On the way up, a guide distributed maps to everyone. In the middle of the climb, we stopped at a small establishment that sold hot soup. The owner told us about a man who got lost on the mountain years ago. For two days, people found no trace of him. But he was a survivor: he stayed in a small empty house and was found on the third day. At the top, we watched the stars fade as the sun came up. I still owe my dad a big thank-you for this trip.
items.passageZh: 去年，我們全家去日本爬富士山。出發前，我們得適應早起，因為我們打算凌晨三點出發。上山途中，一位嚮導把地圖分發給每個人。爬到一半，我們在一家賣熱湯的小店停下來。老闆跟我們說起多年前一個在山上迷路的人。整整兩天，大家都找不到他的任何蹤跡。但他活了下來：他待在一間沒人住的小屋裡，第三天被人找到。到了山頂，我們看著星星在太陽升起時漸漸消失。這趟旅行，我到現在還欠爸爸一聲大大的謝謝。

questions.questionZh: 那位迷路的人後來怎麼了？
options: 他一直沒有被找到，到現在還是個謎
他待在小屋裡，第三天被找到

rubricZh: owe 表示「欠」，例如 owe someone something 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 adapt 造一個句子，說說你適應某個新環境的經驗。
referenceEn: I adapted quickly to life in a big city.
It took me a while to adapt to the cold weather.
rubricZh: adapt 表示「適應」，例如 adapt to… 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
